metric.name: frame_p95_ms
metric.sql_used:
INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE android.frames.timeline;
WITH
  window_frames AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.upid, f.ui_thread_utid, a.id, a.dur, a.jank_type
    FROM android_frames_layers AS f
    JOIN actual_frame_timeline_slice AS a ON a.id = f.actual_frame_timeline_id
    WHERE f.layer_name NOT GLOB '*SurfaceView*' AND a.dur > 0
  ),
  app AS (
    SELECT upid FROM window_frames GROUP BY upid ORDER BY count(*) DESC, upid LIMIT 1
  ),
  frames AS (
    SELECT * FROM window_frames WHERE upid = (SELECT upid FROM app)
  ),
  ranked AS (
    SELECT dur AS ns, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY dur) AS rank, count(*) OVER () AS n
    FROM frames
  )
SELECT (SELECT ns / 1e6 FROM ranked WHERE rank = (n * 95 + 99) / 100) AS value

claims.text: The selected user-facing frame metric improved: frame p95 decreased from 76.544292 ms in baseline to 73.255125 ms in current, a delta of -3.289166999999992 ms.

INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE android.frames.timeline;
WITH
  window_frames AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.upid, f.ui_thread_utid, a.id, a.dur, a.jank_type
    FROM android_frames_layers AS f
    JOIN actual_frame_timeline_slice AS a ON a.id = f.actual_frame_timeline_id
    WHERE f.layer_name NOT GLOB '*SurfaceView*' AND a.dur > 0
  ),
  app AS (
    SELECT upid FROM window_frames GROUP BY upid ORDER BY count(*) DESC, upid LIMIT 1
  ),
  frames AS (
    SELECT * FROM window_frames WHERE upid = (SELECT upid FROM app)
  )
SELECT f.upid AS app_upid, f.ui_thread_utid, p.name AS process_name, t.name AS thread_name,
  count(*) AS frame_count
FROM frames AS f
JOIN process AS p ON p.upid = f.upid
JOIN thread AS t ON t.utid = f.ui_thread_utid
GROUP BY f.upid, f.ui_thread_utid, p.name, t.name

claims.text: Git blame places the watched-row player-acquisition expression in FeedScreen.kt on commit 328304f8f1081e484f20030bb6518b1b1ee03c82, while the range-head FeedScreen change is f871266864fac1b4f44ff750e6a2fc5d5b07d4a1.
Since the localized UI-frame metric improved rather than worsened, the traces do not support attributing a performance regression to either FeedScreen commit.

caveats: Only one capture is available for each build, so small differences remain subject to run-to-run noise.
The current run is a non-debuggable benchmark capture on the sdk_gphone64_arm64 emulator.
The two traces contain different numbers of UI frames, so whole-trace aggregate counters should not be treated as directly normalized latency.
